issues.description: Class method Bitmap24::save has a return-type mismatch in the template repository: example_program/src/Bitmap24.hpp (template) declares the method as 'int save(const std::string &i_filename);' while the implementation in example_program/src/Bitmap24.cpp (template) defines it as 'void Bitmap24::save(const std::string &i_filename)'. The solution repository consistently uses the 'void' return type. This inconsistency (declaration vs. definition) in the template will cause compilation errors and confuses students about the intended API.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the template header declaration with the implementation and the solution: change the declaration in example_program/src/Bitmap24.hpp from 'int save(const std::string &i_filename);' to 'void save(const std::string &i_filename);'. Verify and update any call sites if they rely on an int return value (the current code in main.cpp treats save as void).
